name: release_busy_attempt_skips
setup: SELECT release_test.boot(); SELECT no_release_test.close(); SELECT release_test.boot('two'); SELECT no_release_test.close('two');
a:
SELECT 1 FROM listing_publication_private.attempts WHERE id=final_test.a() FOR UPDATE;
SELECT final_test.check('release_busy_attempt_skips_a',true);
b:
DO $d$ DECLARE r jsonb; BEGIN r:=release_test.seal(); IF (r->>'object_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM completion_test.obj('source','two') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'wrong_object'; END IF; END $d$;
SELECT final_test.check('release_busy_attempt_skips_b',true);
